entities.title: "All the games" on the scores page leads to the site's home
entities.summary: The scores page's side link "← All the games" points at /, which on icelander.net is the home page, not the games.
entities.expected: The link leads to the games page, /games/, as the page's own navigation and footer do.
entities.observed: scoresPage writes href="/". It pointed at /games/ when the page was added, changed to / when the games moved to games.icelander.net (where / was the games page), and was not changed back when they moved to icelander.net/games/retro/.

origin.description: Found while reading scores-page.ts and its history (commits abd19dd and 4bc32c5) for the .dev files.
